title: Listening to and understanding messages
summary: Practise Spanish messages and announcements. Ask an adult to read them aloud to practise listening.
keyIdeas: Listening carefully helps us understand other people's messages.
To understand an announcement, notice what happens, who speaks and where it happens.
Listening carefully and waiting for our turn help us communicate respectfully.

activities.prompt: Paying attention to the speaker helps us understand their message.
activities.explanation: Listen carefully. Looking at the speaker can help, but eye contact is not required for good listening.

activities.prompt: The teacher announces: «Hoy jugamos dentro porque llueve». What is happening outside?
activities.explanation: The announcement says they are playing indoors because it is raining.
activities.hint: Notice why they are not going outside.

activities.prompt: Choose the Spanish word that completes the listening tip.
activities.explanation: Being quiet helps us hear explanations clearly.
activities.sentence: Cuando otra persona habla en clase, debemos guardar ___.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish spoken message to where it is heard.
activities.explanation: Different spoken messages belong to different everyday situations.

pairs.left: «La cena ya está servida en la mesa».

activities.prompt: Aisha tells Hugo: «Mi gata blanca saltó al tejado». Find the mistake in Hugo's reply.
activities.explanation: Hugo changes the animal. Aisha spoke about her cat, not a dog.
activities.hint: Look for the sentence that changes the animal.

activities.prompt: Sort these actions by whether they help or disturb listening to a story.
activities.explanation: Quiet attention helps listening. Talking and making noise disturb others.

items.text: Make noise with the pencil case

activities.prompt: The group leader says: «Poneos la gorra verde para subir al autobús». What should they put on?
activities.explanation: The message asks for a green cap.
activities.hint: Remember the item and colour in the message.

activities.prompt: Ask an adult to read the Spanish announcement aloud. Listen and answer; you can also check the text.
activities.explanation: Finding the details in an announcement tells us what to prepare.
activities.title: Aviso de la excursión
activities.text: Atención, clase de primero. Mañana visitamos la granja de animales. Tenéis que traer una botella de agua pequeña y una fruta para almorzar. Llevad zapatillas cómodas para caminar por el campo.

questions.prompt: Where is the class going on its trip?
questions.explanation: The announcement says they are visiting an animal farm.

questions.prompt: Which food should they bring for their snack?
questions.explanation: The announcement asks them to bring a piece of fruit.

activities.prompt: Omar hears: «Lávate las manos antes de merendar». What should he do first?
activities.explanation: The Spanish word antes means before. Washing his hands is the first action.
activities.hint: Find what the instruction says to do first.
